resources.string: Tap to edit · Long-press and drag to reorder
Plain text is inserted literally. For a sequence, start with #!keys, then one action per line: text …, ctrl+c, shift+enter, ctrl+alt+left, F1–F12, tab, escape, or wait 500 (milliseconds).
Key sequences run their actions in order when tapped.

Invalid key sequence. Use text …, a key (enter, tab, escape, arrows, home, end, pageup, pagedown, insert, delete, backspace, F1–F12, space, plus, or a character) with ctrl/alt/shift/meta/super joined by +, or wait 1–10000. Total waits must not exceed 60000 ms.
